text:
Maya_CS: heads-up — Lumen Health onboarding returned the DPA + SOC2 intake. they flagged two items: non-prod data access (PHI) and they require BYOK for prod. can security confirm what we can commit on non-prod and sample KMS policy? link to their form: https://redwood.share/forms/lumen-dpa

Ethan_dev: thanks. quick q — do they plan to persist embeddings from PII in non-prod? retention window?

Maya_CS: they wrote: "we will index user messages for search/autosuggest, retention 180 days, BYOK required in production." non-prod they asked for a scrubbed dataset but also asked for a dev environment mirror for QA (possible exception).

Samir_SRE: we can support BYOK for Private and Dedicated. need region + whether they want HSM-backed keys. non-prod: we can offer pseudonymized copies, but full PHI in dev will need a formal exception and extra controls. @Ethan_dev will that break QA?

Ethan_dev: QA prefers replayable traces, so full fidelity helps, but we can likely use tokenized identifiers instead. i'll confirm with engineering if pseudonymization is acceptable for their test cases.

Kara_PM: product side is fine to support BYOK for Dedicated/Private customers. we should provide a short KMS policy + a rotation plan to include in the onboarding pack. also update onboarding checklist to capture the exception path for non-prod PHI.

Samir_SRE: sample KMS guidance (draft):
```
- Key type: HSM-backed (recommended) or AES256 software-managed
- Rotation: automatic 90d rotation, manual rotation supported
- IAM: grant service principal encrypt/decrypt, restrict key usage to customer VPC
- Audit: enable key usage logs to our audit pipeline and customer's SIEM
```

Maya_CS: perfect, thanks. action items: Samir -> final KMS policy + sample IAM JSON by Tue EOD; Ethan -> confirm if pseudonymized embeddings cover QA needs; Maya -> update customer and schedule follow-up security call for Wednesday. :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: ticket created CS-5789 for DPA follow-up. assignees: Samir_SRE, Ethan_dev, Maya_CS.
